title: fix(app-shell): draw a flow branch that skips a node around it, its label where no card covers it
body:
Fixes #13144

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

On the flow canvas every forward edge was the same vertical curve from the source card's bottom to the target card's top (`edgePath`), with its branch pill at the curve's midpoint (`edgeMidpoint`). Only back edges took a detour (`backEdgePath`). So a Decision branch that skips a rank (the card's Start → Decision → Notify → End, plus a Decision → End branch) ran straight under the Notify card. The line was hidden under the card, the pill sat under it, and a click there selected Notify.

## What changed

- **`flow-canvas-layout.ts`: new `forwardEdgeRoute(from, to, obstacles, labelSize?)`.** It samples the old curve against every node box except the edge's own two.
  - **No box crossed:** the edge comes back as before, byte for byte: `edgePath` for the path and `edgeMidpoint` for the pill.
  - **A box crossed:** the edge turns aside onto a vertical lane, runs down it and turns back into the target's top. The lane sits `DETOUR_LANE_GAP` (24px, never more than `PADDING`) outside the boxes the edge would cross, and moves further out past any neighbouring box it would run through.
  - **Choosing a side:** a left lane and a right lane are both built and checked against every box. The one that crosses fewer boxes wins, then the one with the shorter way across. A tie goes left, away from the right-hand lane that revise loops use. The pill sits on the lane, below the first turn, in the open band above the first box.
- **The same "label under a node" symptom on an edge between two cards.** An edge can skip a rank by running in the 44px gap between two cards. It crosses neither card, so its path stays the same. But its pill sat at the midpoint, in that rank, under both cards. When the caller passes the pill's size, the router moves the pill along the same curve to the open band below the source, next to the sibling branch pills. With no size (the region view draws no pills), nothing moves.
- **`FlowCanvas.tsx`** draws everything on the route: the stroke, the wide transparent hit path, the pill, the insert handle and the problem badge. It passes each branch pill's estimated size. The Problems-panel reveal pans to the routed pill point.
- **`flow-region-view.tsx`** routes nested-region edges through the same function. It passes no pill size.
- **No public surface moves:** no export from the package entry, prop, schema key or accept set changes. `flow-canvas-layout` is not reachable from the package entry.

## Browser reading (console preview gallery, no backend)

Recipe: objectui's `verify` skill. Run `cd apps/console && pnpm exec vite --port 5291 --strictPort`, open `/preview-gallery.html?only=flow`, and drive it with the repo's Playwright (`executablePath: '/opt/pw-browsers/chromium'`).

The gallery's flow sample has no Decision → End branch that skips a node. So the readings used three local-only edits to `apps/console/src/preview-samples.ts`. None of them is in this PR:

- **A, the card's flow:** the sample's nodes and edges are replaced with start → decide → notify → end. decide → notify is `isDefault`; decide → end has `condition: "record.status != 'done'"`.
- **B, the stock sample plus one edge:** `{ id: 'e_check_end', source: 'check', target: 'end', condition: "record.status != 'done'" }`.
- **C, between siblings:** start → decide; decide → a and decide → b (with conditions); a → end and b → end; plus decide → end with the same condition.

Each reading does four things:

1. Pans the canvas so the pill is in view.
2. Checks the drawn path at 201 points against every card's rect, and compares the pill's rect with every card.
3. Asks the browser which element is topmost at the pill's centre.
4. Clicks that point with a real mouse, then reads which edge the canvas marks as selected.

The "after" rows were read on this branch. A was read again at the final head.

| reading | path points inside a card | pill rect against the cards | topmost at pill centre | real click on the pill selects |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A, main | notify 74 | overlaps notify | node notify | node notify, no edge |
| A, branch | none | overlaps none | the pill | edge decide → end |
| B, main | wait 16, task 16, review 16, notify 16, enrich 16 | in the task / review gap, under task → review's insert handle | the svg layer, not the pill | nothing; task → review's node palette opened |
| B, branch | none | overlaps none | the pill | edge check → end |
| C, main | none (the line runs in the gap) | overlaps a and b | the pill (its middle shows in the gap) | edge decide → end |
| C, branch | none (path unchanged) | overlaps none | the pill | edge decide → end |

Path against the skipped node in A, in canvas coordinates. Notify's box is x 28 to 268, y 272 to 338.

- **main:** `M 148,216 C 148,305 148,305 148,394`. This is a vertical line at x 148, through Notify's box, and the pill point (148, 305) is inside it.
- **branch:** `M 148,216 C 148,230 4,230 4,244 L 4,338 C 4,366 148,366 148,394`. The lane at x 4 stays 24px left of Notify. The pill point (4, 258) is in the band between the Decision's bottom (216) and Notify's top (272).

The stock sample's own `e_skip_end` (Mark as not due → End, which has no pill) was already drawn through four cards on main. 401 points on the old curve fall inside task 32, review 53, notify 44 and enrich 32. The branch draws `M 432,826 C 432,840 434,840 434,854 L 434,1436 C 434,1464 290,1464 290,1492`: it runs down the right-hand side, and no point falls inside a card.

## Tests

The new tests are `forwardEdgeRoute — an edge that skips a node is drawn around it (objectui#13144)` (10 cases, in the existing `flow-canvas-layout.test.ts`) and `FlowCanvas.skipEdgeRoute-13144.test.tsx` (6 cases, DOM). The DOM cases read each card's box from its `left`/`top`/`width`/`height` styles and the pill's box from its `foreignObject`. They pin four things:

- the path and the hit path stay clear of every card;
- the pill box overlaps no card;
- the between-siblings pill leaves the rank;
- region-view edges stay clear of region nodes.

One DOM case is labelled as a control. Happy-dom does no hit-testing, so the pill's click wiring passes on main too. The real click is in the browser table above.

Runs (repo root, through the shared verify lock):

- **New tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=verbose packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-canvas-layout.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FlowCanvas.skipEdgeRoute-13144.test.tsx` gave `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 49 passed (49)` at `84e17ad`. `b596a0d` changes only the changeset.
- **Flow suites:** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the `previews/FlowCanvas`, `previews/FlowPreview`, `previews/flow-`, `previews/flowFieldChrome`, `previews/__tests__` and `inspectors/FlowNodeInspector` path filters gave `Test Files 72 passed (72)`, `Tests 842 passed (842)` on the `84e17ad` tree.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` exited 0. Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exited 0. The second project compiles the package's tests.

Ablations, each through `ablation-replace.mjs` with an anchor that must hit, and restored to a blob equal to HEAD:

1. **The router neutralised**, at `298ce70`: `if (obstacles.length === 0) return straight;` was replaced by `return straight;`. Result: 7 failed, 39 passed. The failures were the four routing cases in `flow-canvas-layout.test.ts`, the two canvas path/pill cases and the region-view case. The cases that stayed green are the unchanged-path controls and the click-wiring control.
2. **The pill move neutralised**, at `84e17ad`: the midpoint early return in `straightLabel` became unconditional. Result: 2 failed, 47 passed. The failures were `moves the pill of an edge running between two cards out of their rank, onto the same path` and `draws the straight line and puts the pill where no card covers it`.

Repo-wide lint and the full test farm are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Pill past the frame.** A lane beside a card in the leftmost column runs inside the diagram's 28px padding (x 4 when the column starts at 28). The pill is centred on the lane, though, so a long pill reaches up to half its width left of the frame that `size` describes. Fit-to-view frames `size` only, so when the fit is limited by width the pill's left part can sit off-canvas. Back-edge pills already reach past the right side the same way. Not changed here.
- **Crowded pill band.** A pill moved below its source shares that band with its sibling branches' pills. `layoutBranchLabels` narrows each pill to the distance to its neighbour minus 8px. In reading C that is 63px, so the pill reads "if recor…" and the full wording stays in its tooltip. In edit mode an insert handle, which always sits to the right of its own pill, can overlap the next pill. That handle rule is the existing one: a three-way decision with long labels hits it today.
- **No upward detour.** A forward edge whose target is not below its source (possible only with manual positions) is never detoured, because there is no room going down. It keeps `edgePath`.
- **Short first turn.** The first turn takes half the open band below the source (at most 28px), and the pill gets the other half. With the 56px auto-layout gap, a 144px sideways turn happens over 28px, which reads as a short hook.
- **README left as is.** The `Visual flow canvas` example in `packages/app-shell/README.md` has exactly this shape: decide → end, `isDefault`, label "Skip", past the email node. Its prose ("rendered as labels on the connectors") is still true, so the README is not edited; it is outside this claim's file surface.
- **Findings filed:** none.
